test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A vendor bought 25 dozen fruits for Rs. 3,750. Out of these, 50 fruits were rotten and therefore thrown away. At what rate per dozen (in) should he sell the remaining to gain 20% in the entire transaction?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) = Rs. 3,750

Gain(P) = 20%

**Formula used:**

**P\% = ((SP-CP)×100)/(CP)**

**Calculation:**

A** **vendor bought fruits = 25 dozen = 25 × 12 = 300 

Rotten fruits = 50

Remaining fruits = 300 - 50 = 250

**⇒ 20 = ((SP-3750)×100)/(3750)**

**⇒** (SP - 3750) × 100 = 20 × 3750

⇒ SP - 3750 = 750

⇒ SP = Rs. 4500

Selling price (SP) = Rs. 4500

Now,

The selling price of 250 fruits = Rs. 4500

The selling price of 12 fruits or one dozen fruits = 4500 × 12/250 = Rs. 216

**∴ The selling price per dozen is Rs. 216**

1a
